title: CSP Input
description: Prevents Content-Security-Policies that look strict but stop nothing by reading the policy the way a browser does: it flags 'unsafe-inline' without a nonce, 'unsafe-eval', * and data: or https: in script-src, a missing default-src, object-src or base-uri, unquoted keywords, a missing semicolon or a stray comma (which splits a header into two policies), allowlisted hosts known to serve JSONP or AngularJS, typo'd or duplicate directives and report-only traps (a Report-Only header pasted as the real one, no report endpoint, a report-only <meta> tag), pins each to its directive in a readout and fixes most in one tap.
